title: API Error (RFC 7807 problem+json)
description: Standard error format for all REST APIs on both sides. Follows RFC 7807.

type.description: URI identifying the error type. e.g. 'https://errors.hybrid-ai.example/schema-validation'

title.description: Short, human-readable summary of the problem.

detail.description: Human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence.

trace_id.description: The trace ID for correlation. Always present.

pointer.description: JSON Pointer to the field that caused the error.
